limitations: Synthetic corpus and one sample per arm; no population/generalized significance claim.
Two baseline types remain separate; constrained FTS5 windows were used where complete authorized documents did not fit32K.
Actual billed charges and reasoning tokens unavailable. Cached counters are reported separately, not added to total tokens.
Submitted message bytes exclude unobservable server-rendered chat-template bytes.
Mechanical gates are necessary but not sufficient; exact quotation validity does not prove citation-to-claim support.
Offline retrieval changes do not alter any historical response, token count or semantic judgment.
No human reviewer contacted or substituted by automated judgment.

timing_definitions.completion_seconds: Monotonic duration from before explicit preload through response processing, before cleanup; excludes preflight and unload.
timing_definitions.full_arm_seconds: Receipt finished UTC minus started UTC, including preflight and cleanup; wall clock rather than monotonic.
timing_definitions.inference_seconds: Wall interval around content POST /api/chat only; separate explicit preload/unload excluded.
timing_definitions.native_load_seconds: Ollama load_duration on content response; separate explicit preload time excluded.
